en.title: Automated Target Lane Allocation
en.excerpt: How Archeris algorithms distribute athletes across target butts by category, session, and club separation rules.
en.content:
Auto-Allocation Logic

The Archeris Auto-Assign algorithm groups verified participants by Category and Distance, determining the exact number of target butts required and filling positions 1A, 1B, 1C, and 1D systematically.

Executing the Auto-Assign Action

To run automatic lane assignments:

  1. Navigate to Tournament Dashboard > Target Allocation.
  2. Select the target Qualification Session from the dropdown.
  3. Click the Auto-Assign Targets button.
  4. Confirm the action in the prompt dialog. The interactive range grid populates instantly.

Club Separation & Fair Distribution

To promote fair competition and prevent coaching conflicts on the shooting line, the algorithm distributes athletes from the same club across adjacent butts rather than grouping them all on a single target face.

Multi-Session Range Allocation

If your tournament has more participants than physical targets, assign categories to separate morning and afternoon sessions. The auto-allocator processes each session independently.
